rule: MUST-FOLLOW rule 13: one standard footer, the same on every surface: one row of links plus one short line. Never two rows of links. Light only: paper tint background, ink text, link-blue links.
external_rule: Append the external mark to a link whose host differs from the current site's; a link to the current site is a relative path with no mark.

line.eranos: This browser keeps only your requests’ private links. Nothing else is stored.
line.default: Part of ta-amps: spare AI tokens, for good.

layout.brand: the tile mark and the surface's name, before the links, on the same row
layout.links: one row, separated by gaps, wrapping only when the screen is too narrow
layout.line: one short line under the row, at 14 px
